column1: # Game profile of DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER (Switch, base game 1.0.0, v0). Plays on Android (Retroid Pocket Nova)
# Unity 2022.3.62f3 (IL2CPP) with FMOD, SDK 19.3.14; subsdk0 is the movie module (the opening movie). Nearly everything is in 20,380 Addressables bundles
# (StreamingAssets/aa/Switch). The game presents at interval 2 (30 fps, main+0xcfb728). Its control data lists Korean
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap. nninitStartup hands pool − used to StandardAllocator as one address region (3.14 GB
# with the Switch's pool) and Unity reserves its own beside it: in a 4.375 GB alias region that filled at +4.37 GB 9 s in (4.15 GB reserved, 1.28 GB mapped) and the game crashed.
# A 1 GB pool, as Castlevania: Belmont's Curse's (the same Unity 2022.3); the sdk build gets the node-area cut (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py).
# With those the regions' high-water mark still went from +2.76 GB to +4.37 GB in 18 minutes of play with 2.5 GB reserved (Unity's 16 and 64 MB blocks come and go and new ones
# land ever higher: about 0.1 GB a minute). The alias region is the console's 64 GB (256 MB in front + 64 GB + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap region), as MARVEL Cosmic
# Invasion's; a 12.4 GB one was at +3.75 GB after 2 minutes
